item.title: Oyedele Urges Nigerians to File Annual Tax Returns, Warns Against Non-Compliance
item.description: The Chairman of the Presidential Committee on Fiscal Policy and Tax Reforms, Taiwo Oyedele, has urged Nigerians to comply with tax regulations by submitting their annual tax returns, stressing that the obligation applies to both individuals and employers. item.title: Ecobank Records 43% Profit Surge, Hits N702.4bn on Stronger Revenue and Cost Efficiency
item.description: Ecobank Transnational Incorporated (ETI), the parent company of Ecobank Nigeria and other subsidiaries across Africa, has reported a significant 43% year-on-year surge in profit, hitting N702.4 billion for the financial year ended September 2025.
